datasets.suitability_reason: Function-call baseline; no latent state in cached tasks.
datasets.sample_form: natural-language request, tool schema, and all argument values
datasets.task: emit an order-independent list of typed function calls
datasets.example: create two histograms from two supplied arrays, both with bins=5
datasets.jev_strength_reason: Arguments and call multiplicity are explicit; there is no latent action state.

datasets.suitability_reason: Function-call baseline; independent calls are explicit.
datasets.sample_form: one request containing several independent tools and complete arguments
datasets.task: emit all required typed calls without prose
datasets.example: two currency conversions, a distance conversion, and a weight conversion
datasets.jev_strength_reason: Independent tool calls are explicit and have no feedback in the cached task.

datasets.suitability_reason: Interactive finite action and observation transitions.
datasets.sample_form: observation with goal, current position, and local walls
datasets.task: choose a move from a fixed four-action set; apply it in the local simulator and consume the next observation
datasets.jev_strength_reason: The native simulator supplies a new observation after each finite move.

datasets.suitability_reason: API slot filling; cached level-1 examples have no tool feedback loop.
datasets.sample_form: dialogue context, API description, and filled user slots
datasets.task: emit the single API request matching the dialogue
datasets.example: modify an appointment using the supplied appointment ID, date, and doctor
datasets.jev_strength_reason: The cached level-1 sample is direct API slot filling without a tool transition.

datasets.suitability_reason: Finite symbolic branch, but no spawning topology.
datasets.sample_form: a custom arithmetic rule and an expression
datasets.task: select the applicable divisibility branch and compute the scalar result
datasets.example: compute 4※7 under a rule that returns 24 when neither operand divides the other
datasets.jev_strength_reason: A single deterministic rule branch has no meaningful spawn topology.

datasets.suitability_reason: Finite extraction, but no sequential environment.
datasets.sample_form: a list of words and a stated common pattern
datasets.task: extract the finite substring or abbreviation from each word in order
datasets.example: extract embedded weekday abbreviations from seven words
datasets.jev_strength_reason: Independent finite string extraction has no state transition.

datasets.suitability_reason: Finite flight graph with time and event state.
datasets.sample_form: cities, stay durations, direct-flight graph, and calendar events in one natural-language query
datasets.task: return a complete itinerary satisfying every travel and temporal constraint
datasets.example: visit seven cities in 17 days with an Istanbul event on days 1-4 and a Seville wedding on days 15-17
datasets.jev_strength_reason: A route-and-calendar state can be simulated, but a one-shot itinerary is ordinary planning rather than JEV.

datasets.sample_form: action rules, initial block predicates, goal predicates, and a plan slot
datasets.task: emit an executable pick/unstack/put/stack sequence whose simulated state reaches the goal
datasets.example: move yellow on top of red while preserving the red-blue-orange stack
datasets.jev_strength_reason: The local block simulator can apply each finite action and return the successor state.

datasets.suitability_reason: Coupled finite assignment with constraint feedback.
datasets.sample_form: complete logic-grid puzzle with finite entities, attribute domains, and natural-language clues
datasets.task: assign every entity to every attribute while maintaining all relational constraints
datasets.example: four houses with people, heights, drinks, children, and mothers; clues couple adjacency and ordering
datasets.jev_strength_reason: A finite CSP can provide constraint-check observations, but this becomes JEV only when assignments are executed incrementally.

datasets.output_contract: ranking over a finite document collection
datasets.suitability_reason: Finite document ranking; suitability requires local retrieval evidence.
datasets.sample_form: a Pony programming query plus a fixed collection of candidate documents represented as q_i fields
datasets.task: make one relevance decision per candidate document and rank the relevant documents
datasets.example: a prime-number Pony query with 119 document-relevance fields, each yes/no
datasets.jev_strength_reason: The document fields support wide finite readout, but the current task has no sequential observation loop.

datasets.output_contract: typed attribute records with source spans
datasets.suitability_reason: Typed attribute extraction; not yet an adaptive state transition task.
datasets.sample_form: product title and description with typed attribute targets and evidence spans
datasets.task: extract attribute values, normalize them, and bind each value to source text
datasets.example: HP Xeon E5335 listing with generation, part number, cache, clock speed, and processor core fields
datasets.jev_strength_reason: Typed extraction and span binding are structured, but static.
